Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa

Class TrustedDeviceController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa.TrustedDeviceController
All Implemented Interfaces:
TrustedDevicesApi
@RestController public class TrustedDeviceController extends Object implements TrustedDevicesApi
Lists and revokes the trusted devices of the authenticated account. The paths, status codes and bodies are those of the contract apis/auth-server/rest-server/auth-server-api-v1.yaml, through the generated TrustedDevicesApi; failures are answered by MfaExceptionHandler. Revoking a device needs a recent multi-factor sign-in (StepUpGuard).
